results.name: Small Retro Diorama
results.description:
These objects are part of my 80s retro room diorama, but since i have half of the objects textured by now, i thought it was a great idea to publish some of the ones i have textured already while i finish the rest.

So here in the scene i have the **Atari 2600** with a controller, **3 Atari cartridges** (Space Invaders, Adventure and Asteroids), the **vintage TV** with some stickers, some **80s Comics** (Kraven's Last Hunt vol 4, Batman Year One vol 4 and Watchmen vol 1), **80s Pepsi cans** and **Lays potato chips bag**

-

***Just if you are curious:*** The most difficult part of this is finding and being able to apply the textures of objects such as cartridges, comics, the potatoes bags, not to mention the cans, **I had to completely recreate the can label by hand** because there are no useful textures of the same on the entire internet apparently.

results.name: Indian snacks - Balaji - Kurkure - Chips
results.description:
This is a low-poly, game-ready 3D asset of a "Babuji Chatak-Patak" masala snack bag, designed specifically for environmental world-building and player interaction in a Unity game. This asset is a stylized parody of common Indian snacks, using original names and fictional regulatory symbols to ensure IP safety while maintaining that authentic roadside kirana store vibe.

The front face features high-resolution graphics of spicy puffed corn sticks. The back features fully realized, satirical details, including a custom "Level 10 Gamer Fuel" barcode and joke ingredients like "90% Air" and "1% Luck," perfect for FPS or RPG "inspect mode" mechanics.
